pages.text: The Slaughterhouse rolls the captured animal's actual entity loot table once per consumed individual. Variant state and datapack changes apply. Counts are multiplied by the server's slaughterhouseYieldMultiplier setting (default 2, range 1â€“64) and split into legal stacks.$(br)$(br)Prepared results survive blocked outputs, power loss and reloads. The machine uses a non-player, non-looting context; player-only drops are not granted.

Packmakers: empty itemOutputs opt into entity loot. Nonempty itemOutputs are explicit static products, keep their listed chances and counts, and are not multiplied. Retained animal catalysts never grant death loot.$(br)$(br)The multiplier affects new transactions only. Oversized loot exceeding 256 output stacks pauses safely before consuming anything; reduce the multiplier or loot-table yield. A full output inventory also prevents consumption.

pages.title: Construction
pages.text: 5 × 7 × 4 sealed processing line. West intake, internal drive units and east discharge communicate the flow. Narrow inspection windows and a vented spine replace the old red glass tower; no decorative gore.$(br)$(br)2 drive, 18 frame, 6 framed glass, 4 grow light, 61 panel, 7 vent. Plus the controller and 5 hatches shown in the preview.$(br)$(br)Only the current guide layout forms. Retired 2.5 layouts and the 2.6 Habitat require rebuilding. Finish active cycles and empty hatches before updating; do not break a loaded controller or hatch. Smart Hammer fills cleared spaces from inventory but cannot replace solid blocks.
